As a machine operator, you ensure the mechanical packing process runs smoothly. You precisely set up the packaging lines, such as the Cover-One packing machine, the box folder and the box stacker. While the lines are running, you continuously monitor quality and progress. 
If a machine jams, you know how to act quickly. You resolve minor technical faults independently, and for bigger issues, you communicate clearly with your colleagues in Dutch, German or English. Alongside the technical work, you keep the administration around traceability, batch numbers and KPIs neat and up to date. Periodic maintenance and cleaning of your machines are also part of your responsibilities. 
Because you're a real hands-on worker, you don't mind helping out with manual packing work when the schedule requires it. The workday often starts early, and you'll work 38 hours per week, with a willingness to work an average of two Saturdays a month or in shifted schedules between 04:00 and 21:00. You'll find yourself in a great workplace with dedicated colleagues and plenty of job security.
